node.title: Re^3: scp file from windows10 to unix server
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I think the problem is that either the source file or the destination (probably the latter) is not being found.

You don't need to guess: As [id://11113094|I said], better error handling in Perl will help, and also you can always try things at the command line and compare the errors you get: Try using the command line to copy a file that doesn't exist locally, and to a destination that causes an error.
